overview.description: The AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM US Core ETF (DWUS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of funds of US large-caps that follows a proprietary rules-based momentum strategy and seeks long-term capital appreciation. DWUS was launched on Dec 26, 2019 and is issued by AdvisorShares.

completeness: holdings are every row of the issuer's per-fund holdings file, all carrying the file's single date 2026-10-12
the file publishes a signed portfolio weight and a cash row, so weights are kept signed with no sum-to-100 check
the file publishes no shares outstanding or AUM, so quote stays empty
only the first row carries the account symbol and date; later rows inherit both, and a nonblank unreadable date is refused instead of inherited
Shares/Par holds currency on cash and money-market rows, so those rows keep the value in provider_quantity and leave shares null
